ae5ed1ada1a1e815a2c94077152490ba179b4c4e.summary: A GitHub README for a tool that uses the Speakeasy Emulation Framework to unpack a Conti ransomware sample found on MalwareBazaar. The author says the tool does not fully work and cannot explain why only parts of the .rdata section are written under emulation. The page names no threat actors, sectors, countries or CVEs.

tools.q: The unpacker uses the Speakeasy Emulation Framework to run and unpack the sample.

techniques.q: The unpacker uses the Speakeasy Emulation Framework to run and unpack the sample.

figures.q: I can't figure out why this is happening because Speakeasy is pretty weird, so this unpacker does not work 100%.
